_comment: Labelled retrieval questions for the recall gate.
Ground truth is a CHAPTER, not a chunk id. Chunk ids are assigned in file
order by scripts/fetch_corpus.py, so they change whenever the chunker or the
upstream extraction changes -- and a gate keyed on them would go red on every
corpus regeneration for reasons unrelated to retrieval quality. A gate that
cries wolf gets deleted, so this one is labelled at a granularity that
Two sets. The first twelve are phrased in the document's own vocabulary and
were written alongside the chunker -- which is exactly why they were too easy:
recall@3 was 1.00, and a gate that never moves has stopped measuring.
The fifteen marked 'paraphrase' ask the same questions the way a grower or an
agronomist would, avoiding the manual's terms. They are the harder half and
they are where a chunking regression will show first.
These are authored questions, not invented data: the corpus is FAO's and
untouched. Same kind of artefact as the golden eval cases -- a human saying
what a right answer looks like.

questions.query: readily available water RAW and the management allowed depletion fraction p
questions.why: The irrigation trigger this system computes. Chapter 8 defines RAW = p x TAW.

questions.query: total available water from field capacity wilting point and rooting depth
questions.why: TAW is the ceiling the running water balance is clamped to.

questions.query: crop coefficient Kc mid-season stage for vines and fruit trees
questions.why: Deps.kc's source. The passage explains it; Deps still supplies the number.

questions.query: crop evapotranspiration ETc equals ETo multiplied by the crop coefficient
questions.why: The single line features.py implements.

questions.query: FAO Penman-Monteith equation for reference evapotranspiration ETo
questions.why: Where the ET0 column in the weather feed comes from.

questions.query: wind speed measurement height two metres and adjustment for evapotranspiration
questions.why: The spray gate reasons about wind; the ETo calculation depends on it.

questions.query: dew point temperature relative humidity and vapour pressure deficit
questions.why: Delta-T is reconstructed from temperature and wet bulb; same chapter.

questions.query: water stress coefficient Ks when root zone depletion exceeds RAW
questions.why: What happens past the trigger the advisory recommends acting on.

questions.query: irrigation scheduling to avoid crop water stress and depth of water to apply
questions.why: The advisory's recommended_depth_mm, in the document's own terms.

questions.query: evaporation from bare soil after a wetting event and the evaporation coefficient Ke
questions.why: The dual-coefficient half this system deliberately does not model.

questions.query: how much rainfall infiltrates the root zone and how much is lost to runoff
questions.why: effective_rain_fraction's justification.

questions.query: crop growth stages initial development mid-season and late season lengths
questions.why: Which Kc applies when -- the config decision a grower actually makes.

questions.query: how do I know when the vines actually need watering
questions.why: The grower's phrasing of the RAW/MAD trigger. No manual vocabulary at all.

questions.query: how much water should I put on to refill the soil
questions.why: recommended_depth_mm, asked as a person would.

questions.query: how much water can this soil hold for the plants to use
questions.why: TAW without saying TAW.

questions.query: what happens to the crop when the soil dries out too far
questions.why: The stress coefficient Ks, phrased as a consequence.

questions.query: after a shower how much of that rain do the roots really get
questions.why: Effective rainfall, runoff and deep percolation.

questions.query: how much water does a vineyard use on a hot day
questions.why: ETc = ETo x Kc, asked as a quantity.

questions.query: what does the standard grass reference number from the weather service mean
questions.why: ETo and Penman-Monteith, from the consumer's side.

questions.query: does a young vine use the same amount of water as a mature one in summer
questions.why: Growth stages and the Kc curve.

questions.query: why does a windy day dry the field out faster
questions.why: Wind in the ETo calculation, asked causally.

questions.query: why does the same temperature feel different for evaporation when the air is humid
questions.why: Vapour pressure deficit without the term.

questions.query: does water evaporate from the ground itself or only through the leaves
questions.why: The dual coefficient: Kcb versus Ke.

questions.query: does it matter whether I use drip or flood the rows
questions.why: Wetted fraction and the evaporation component.

questions.query: my irrigation water is a bit salty, does that change how much I should apply
questions.why: Salinity stress, which shares Chapter 8 with water stress.

questions.query: what if the vines only cover part of the ground between the rows
questions.why: Sparse vegetation and partial ground cover.

questions.query: my weather station lost a day of readings, can I still work out the numbers
questions.why: Estimating missing meteorological data.
